transcript:
Meeting header:
2026-08-03 15:00 PDT | Duration: 54 minutes
Attendees: Samir Patel (Redwood AE), Laura Kim (Redwood SE), Nina Ortiz (Redwood PM), Evan Brooks (Sapphire Sales Dir), Maya Singh (Partner Ops), Diego Alvarez (Solutions Architect), Lena Park (Sapphire AE)

Summary (auto): quick pipeline readout, prioritize Acme retail pilot, check technical gating items, confirm next steps.

00:00 Samir Patel: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, appreciate you making time. Quick round robin, who do we have on the call?
00:08 Evan Brooks: Evan here, Maya, Diego, Lena from Sapphire. Thanks Samir.
00:12 Samir Patel: Awesome, so goal for today is a co-sell pipeline review, identify top joint opportunities, align on next steps, and flag any technical blockers. Laura, wanna kick off the technical posture summary?
00:22 Laura Kim: Yeah sure, hi all. On Redwood side we've got Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and the Private deployment for VPC/on-prem. For pilots we usually recommend Hosted for fast time-to-value unless customers require VPC or bring-your-own keys.
00:38 Diego Alvarez: Quick question - Acme has strict data residency and KMS rules; they'd prefer customer-managed keys. Can Redwood support HSM/KMS integration in Private?
00:48 Laura Kim: Yes, we support KMS integrations and an HSM-backed flow on Private. There's a small ops uplift, but doable. That said, we sometimes propose Dedicated with encrypted volumes if full Private is overkill.
00:59 Maya Singh: How about SOC 2 + audit logs? They need pretty heavy audit trail.
01:04 Nina Ortiz: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II, we have audit logs in the Console and can export to customer SIEM. We'll share the security pack after the call.
01:12 Evan Brooks: Great. From a GTM lens, Sapphire's sales team already has a relationship at Acme via their commerce modernization. We think there's a good exec sponsor.
01:22 Samir Patel: Perfect. Let's walk the top three joint opportunities - Acme Retail, NovaHealth, and Beacon Finance.
01:30 Samir Patel: Acme - target pilot for product recommendation generator, need low-latency gen at 100 qps with seq_len around 512 for session contexts. Banked revenue estimate in year one ~$180k.
01:45 Evan Brooks: yep that's the number we're seeing on our side. Scheduling-wise they want a pilot in August.
01:51 Laura Kim: For 100 qps and 512 seq, Dedicated is probably the sweet spot for consistent latency, but if they accept occasional higher p99 we can run Hosted with caching and aggressive batching. Tradeoff: Hosted cheaper upfront, Dedicated predictable cost.
02:09 Lena Park: What's the friction on bringing them into Dedicated? procurement?
02:14 Samir Patel: Mostly commit levels and procurement timing. Also they sometimes ask for private networking which extends timeline.
02:21 Maya Singh: On the co-sell comp side - Sapphire wants clear deal registration and margin split. How do you handle partner compensation?
02:27 Nina Ortiz: We have a co-sell program doc, can share. Generally we do registration, margin or referral credits, and joint opp credit for SDR/AE assists. We'll share the standard template.
02:36 Evan Brooks: Can you put that doc in a format our finance team can evaluate quickly?
02:40 Samir Patel: Absolutely, I'll send the one-pager with pricing bands and the partner legal checklist.
02:45 Laura Kim: Small note, for NovaHealth, their security bar is high: no external data egress, must run Private in their VPC, and they need SAML SSO integration. Also they use an on-prem HSM.
02:58 Diego Alvarez: That one will need an on-prem deployment; we should map the infra requirements now.
03:04 Samir Patel: Let's capture that as a potential longer timeline. Beacon Finance is more flexible, they care about audit and latency but might accept Dedicated.
03:13 Maya Singh: On enablement, Sapphire wants joint demo scripts and a sandbox access for the AE team.
03:19 Nina Ortiz: We'll provide a partner sandbox tenant and a co-branded deck if you want. Also a mock eval harness for quality checks.
03:28 Evan Brooks: That would help. If you can give us a short script we can train our reps quickly.
03:33 Samir Patel: We'll deliver a 1-pager and demo script.
03:36 Laura Kim: Technical gating items quick list: VPC/Network peering, SSO (SAML/OIDC), KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 evidence, expected qps/seq_len, sample datasets for eval, and SLA expectations.
03:50 Diego Alvarez: For Acme pilot I'll send expected QPS and sample payloads.
03:54 Samir Patel: Perfect. Any immediate red flags on contracts or procurement?
03:58 Lena Park: Acme procurement wants vendor insurance certs and sometimes an addendum. Timeline could slide a couple weeks.
04:05 Samir Patel: Noted. We'll include standard vendor pack in the docs.
04:10 Maya Singh: Billing model question - if we start Hosted and later move to Dedicated, is there a migration path or credit?
04:17 Nina Ortiz: We have migration guidance and often provide growth credits when customers commit to Dedicated after a pilot. We'll include that in the partner one-pager.
04:26 Samir Patel: Ok let's do a quick recap and next steps.
04:29 Samir Patel: Action items: Samir to share co-sell one-pager and pricing, Laura to run compatibility checklist for Acme, Maya to send prioritized accounts, Diego to send throughput numbers. We'll plan exec briefing wk of Aug 10 and pilot kickoff Aug 17 for Acme pending procurement.
04:47 Evan Brooks: Sounds good. Thanks everyone.
04:49 Samir Patel: Thanks all, we'll follow up via email and Slack.

Notes:
- Artifacts to be shared: partner program one-pager (link: https://redwood.co/partners/one-pager - placeholder), security pack (link in chat), demo script (attached after call).
- Transcription had minor mis-hears around product names (e.g., 'Redwood Dedicate' instead of 'Redwood Dedicated') which we'll tidy in follow-up notes.

End of transcript.
